name: KJMC Financial Services Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1988, KJMC Finserv Group is a NBFC which is engaged in the business of lending across retail, MSME and commercial customers.
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio:[1]
a) Loan for purchase of Two Wheelers: Company provides loans for purchase of Two wheelers which are used for personal or business purpose. Finance is provided for buying new & used two-wheelers. Loans on two-wheelers is provided on product-specific interest rates and fees. 
b) MSME Loans: Company provides unsecured small ticket business loan which covers funding needs of a business
c) Investments: Company provides investment in financial market through Mutual Funds, Equity Shares, Derivatives, Bonds, etc.[2]

pros: Stock is trading at 0.18 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 0.23% over last 3 years.
